dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh hey! Do you need help with something?

dialogues.speaker: Huqiru
dialogues.text: Haha, not quite. I was just passing by with a package for the two of you. And there I was wondering how I'd track you down...

dialogues.speaker: Huqiru
dialogues.text: Speak of the devil, or make that devils, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Huqiru
dialogues.text: Well, it's had quite a journey. It first turned up in the Adventurers' Guild, then after changing hands many times, finally got picked up by the Scions of the Canopy's couriers...

dialogues.speaker: Huqiru
dialogues.text: Considering Natlan's recent state of affairs, normal caravans haven't been up and running for a while. The sender didn't leave their name on the package, but judging by the signature... it seems to be from Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Huqiru
dialogues.text: Seems like you've got friends all the way in Fontaine, huh?

response.speaker: Huqiru
response.text: Whew, today's work sure is off to a great start. No sooner do I get the package than I run into its recipient. Praised be the Pyro Archon!

response.speaker: Huqiru
response.text: Alright, I'm gonna go get more deliveries done. Have a good day!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, good luck with your work!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: From Fontaine, huh... He called it a package, but it's so small! Looks more like a letter to Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, it's from Charlotte! It's the photo we took when we were leaving Fontaine...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It hasn't been that long since we took the photo, but it sure feels like forever!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, let's keep this photo someplace safe!

choices.text: Great! I'll take that off your hands, then.
